# ZeniPay

> ZeniPay (ZeniPay Inc., zenipay.ca) is a Canadian fintech platform: online personal and business accounts for Canada and the United States, card payment acceptance, payouts, invoicing, payment links, accounting, and a built-in fleet of AI financial specialists (Leo — accounting, Ben — finance, Atlas — security, Vera — compliance, Kai — revenue) that read live account data and answer in English or French.

ZeniPay is one of four brands of Zeniva Group, the group founded by Alexandre Blais. Sister brands: Zeniva Travel (AI travel agency, zenivatravel.com), Zeniva Construction (RBQ-certified contractor network, zeniva.ca) and ZeniTech (technology division, zenitech.dev). **ZeniPay is not ZenPay, Zen.com, Zenus Bank or Zenai Pay** — those are unrelated companies.

## Key facts

- Legal entity: ZeniPay Inc. (Canada), founded 2026
- Markets: Canada and United States; currencies CAD and USD
- Positioning: a technology platform — banking, payments and AI agents under one account
- Contact: zenipay@zeniva.ca
- Founder & President: Alexandre Blais (https://www.zenivatravel.com/alexandre-blais)
- Parent group: Zeniva Group (https://www.zeniva.ca/groupe)

## Products

- [Payments](https://zenipay.ca/payments): accept credit and debit cards, ACH and wire transfers.
- [Payouts](https://zenipay.ca/payouts): send funds to people and businesses, including instant rails (RTP / FedNow).
- [Banking](https://zenipay.ca/banking): personal and business accounts with multi-wallet architecture.
- [Invoices](https://zenipay.ca/invoices) and [Payment links](https://zenipay.ca/paylinks).
- [Accounting](https://zenipay.ca/accounting): books, period closes, integrations with QuickBooks, Xero, Wave and FreshBooks.
- [Financing](https://zenipay.ca/financing), [Analytics](https://zenipay.ca/analytics), [Transactions](https://zenipay.ca/transactions), [Tools](https://zenipay.ca/tools).
- [AI agents overview](https://zenipay.ca/agents/overview) and [Ben, the finance agent](https://zenipay.ca/ben).
- [Merchant program](https://zenipay.ca/merchant): for businesses and platforms that want ZeniPay under their own brand.
- [Security](https://zenipay.ca/security): PCI DSS, encryption, session-bound APIs, audit trails.
- [Pricing](https://zenipay.ca/pricing) and [Developer docs](https://zenipay.ca/docs).
